coverage_explanation: Checks the required output modes, common-anode decoding, initial zero, and the specified 1-, 2-, and 3-second display phases. Samples near both ends of each phase and edge-free interior windows detect incorrect digits, early transitions, and unwanted changes. Behavior after the explicitly specified 3–4 second phase is not constrained.
assumptions: The supplied wiring is authoritative: A,B,C,D,E,F,G map to pins 2,3,4,5,6,7,8; DP maps to pin 9; COM is connected to 5V.
Elapsed seconds are measured from power-on, as stated by the requirement, rather than from setup completion.
The public acceptance profile supplies initial counter value zero and the 500ms setup completion deadline.
No decimal-point behavior or single-digit rollover policy is specified, so neither is asserted. The reference leaves DP off and uses modulo ten after nine seconds.
No bench-default electrical wiring is needed because the circuit is supplied.
